quest.title: Underwater Restoration in Progress...
quest.description: Freminet seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon. Don't worry, I know what's up.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: It seems that the reason there have been so many divers around lately is because everyone's trying to clear away all the underwater junk. They're trying to get the environment back to normal as quickly as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: If that's the case, I should really double down on my own efforts to help.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: If the underwater pollution gets any worse, the colors of the Romaritime Flowers will fade... and that's not all. I don't want to think about all the awful things that might happen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In that case, we'll help out, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's work together to clean up the sea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Freminet, we found this pretty awesome-looking... thingy underwater. We think it might be part of a musical instrument? What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Sure... Wow, this is really intricate. I've studied a fair few mechanisms, but I've never seen anything this detailed or unique.

choices.text: I think we should put it here.

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Hmm... Looks like it's missing some components, though. You'll need to find the rest if you hope to restore it to working order.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's alright, we're not in a hurry. Though, Paimon is curious to see what it looks like once we've put it back together...

response.speaker: Freminet
response.text: Alright, I'd better head back down to help with the cleanup... You two enjoy your rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We will! Make sure not to work too hard yourself.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Huh? This thing... did you fish it out of the sea?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We sure did! Do you know what it is?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Hah, more than that. I know whose it is! I used to sit in the garden and play this thing every day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? So, does that mean... it's yours?

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: It was once. It's a mechanical piano that Alain invented. It can be played by hand, but it also works automatically.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, that's incredible! But why was it...

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: When Alain fell ill, he couldn't bear to listen to the piano anymore, so I got rid of it for him. I never thought I'd see it again...

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: I guess whoever ended up with it played it till it broke, but didn't know how to fix it. Otherwise, it would have never ended up in this state.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: Of course! Fixing something like this is trivial.

response.speaker: Marionette
response.text: The only thing is... it looks to have completely fallen apart. But if you can bring me the missing components, I'll be able to put it back together in no time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! We'll keep an eye out whenever we're underwater!

choices.text: It fits in well with the surroundings.
